purpose: Day 7 offline-only, synthetic cases derived from public platform/standards behavior; not observed attacks
execution_policy: Decode or parse fixture text only. Never navigate, launch an app, download an APK, send a message, or connect Wi-Fi.

cases.scene: 社团票务卡片承诺在 TapLens 中查看，二维码却指定其他包名并留有网页 fallback
cases.source_behavior: Chrome documents intent package and browser_fallback_url syntax; the .test domain is reserved for testing.
cases.expected_taplens: Preview the decoded intent, declared package and fallback. Flag the mismatch with expected com.taplens.app; do not infer installed-app identity.
cases.offline_reproduction: Open existing qr02-intent-package-mismatch.png in TapLens gallery preview or parse the payload as text; never confirm an external action.
cases.provenance: Team-authored fiction; platform syntax paraphrased, no vendor artwork or exploit copied.
cases.license_use: Chrome Developers page text: CC BY 4.0; no text/code copied. RFC 6761: IETF Trust terms; only the reserved-domain rule is referenced.

cases.scene: 卡片上最先看到校园字样，实际 URL host 却是另一虚构站点且路径指向 APK
cases.source_behavior: WHATWG URL syntax separates userinfo before @ from the host after @. A .test host does not represent a real download service.
cases.expected_taplens: Show the parsed host download.example.test or reject credential-bearing URLs; do not present campus.example.test as the destination. Flag an off-store APK path only as a static cue.
cases.offline_reproduction: Parse the literal URL in a local unit test or phone preview without opening it. No APK exists at the .test address.
cases.provenance: Team-authored synthetic URL, not copied from a real phishing campaign.
cases.license_use: WHATWG URL Standard: CC BY 4.0; no text/code copied. RFC 6761: IETF Trust terms; only the reserved-domain rule is referenced.

cases.scene: 社团活动卡片承诺打开指定应用，未安装或无法唤起时却可能回退到另一虚构登录站
cases.source_behavior: Chrome documents a fallback URL when an intent does not launch; Android App Links require association verification before claiming website-to-app identity.
cases.expected_taplens: Decode the package and fallback, mark handler identity and destination behavior unverified, and avoid claiming the fallback actually happened.
cases.offline_reproduction: Feed FIX-DL-004 literal URI to C's static parser; do not dispatch an Android intent or fetch the fallback.
cases.provenance: Team-authored fiction derived from public platform behavior, not a copied exploit.
cases.license_use: Google developer documentation page text: CC BY 4.0; no text/code copied.
